annotations.title: People worth contacting at a company

description: People worth contacting at a company. For "who should I contact at Monzo about data jobs?", "find the hiring manager". Gives the people who posted the company's hiring ads publicly (they asked applicants to get in touch) and ready LinkedIn and Google searches that open the person's own connections there, its recruiters, likely hiring managers for the role, people in the role (for a referral) and alumni of a school. Nothing is read from LinkedIn and nothing is gathered about anyone.
